nodes.label: Industrial Logic Design System
nodes.rationale: Design philosophy: Modern Industrialism for ML engineers. Prioritizes utility, precision, structural integrity. Restrained color palette (slate/blue-gray), 4px spacing rule, flat depth via tonal layers, no gradients, rectangular components. Targets calm authority and technical reliability.

hyperedges.label: UI Industrial Design System applied to all 3 Stitch Workspace Prototypes
